channel.title: Ocean News & Technology Magazine - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Ocean News & Technology Magazine (oceannews.com)

item.title: CSA Ocean Sciences Joins APEM Group
item.description: APEM Group announced that CSA Ocean Sciences, a US-based environmental consultancy supporting energy transition and coastal infrastructure projects worldwide, has joined the Group.

item.title: Airmar Appoints EMEA Sales Manager
item.description: Airmar Technology Corporation, the world leader in transducer technology, has announced the appointment of Thomas Sellier as EMEA Sales Manager. In this role, Sellier will oversee all sales operations for Airmar products across Europe, the Middle East, and Africa and will report to Guillaume Martino, Director Marport Global Sales and Aimar EMEA.

item.title: GeoAcoustics Ltd Appoints Seafloor Systems Inc. as US Channel Partner
item.description: GeoAcoustics Ltd, a global leader in hydroacoustic survey technology, has announced a new channel partnership with Seafloor Systems Inc., a California-based specialist in integrated hydrographic survey solutions. The agreement sees Seafloor Systems represent the entire GeoAcoustics product portfolio in the United States, including the GeoSwath 4 bathymetric sonar, GeoScan side scan sonar, and GeoPulse sub-bottom profiler systems.

item.title: DNV Certifies West Aquifer CO2 Storage Site at Endorsement Stage
item.description: DNV, the independent energy expert and assurance provider, announced that ADNOC has been awarded a CO2 Storage Certificate at the Site Endorsement stage for its West Aquifer CO2 storage development, marking a significant milestone for the United Arab Emirates and the wider region in advancing large scale carbon capture and storage (CCS).

item.title: Marine Powerhouses Line Up for IMarEST Presidency
item.description: The Institute of Marine Engineering, Science and Technology (IMarEST) announced its next two presidents. Offshore renewable energy expert Professor Deborah Greaves of the University of Oxford will take office in April, followed in 2027 by Claudene Sharp Patel, Global Technical Director at Lloyd’s Register. The appointments mark the first time women have held successive presidencies at the Institute.

item.title: Saipem to Supply Hydrone-W Underwater ROV to New Oceanographic Vessel
item.description: Saipem has been awarded a contract with the T. Mariotti shipyard in Genoa to supply the Hydrone-W remotely operated underwater vehicle (ROV) which will be deployed on ISPRA's (Higher Institute for Environmental Protection and Research) new oceanographic vessel Arcadia.

item.title: Fugro Completes Artificial Reef Installation for Woodside and Recfishwest
item.description: Fugro has successfully installed an artificial reef off the coast of Dampier, Western Australia (WA), on behalf of Woodside Energy and Recfishwest, creating a new habitat to support local fish species and enhance recreational fishing opportunities for the community.

item.title: SLB Awarded Multiple Offshore Drilling Contracts for Tangkulo Deepwater Development in Indonesia
item.description: Global energy technology company SLB has been awarded multiple offshore drilling services contracts by Mubadala Energy, the Abu Dhabi headquartered international energy company, for the Tangkulo natural gas deepwater development and associated exploration and appraisal drilling activities in the Andaman Sea, offshore Indonesia.

item.title: EnerMech Secures Major Cranes Contract Extension with Middle Eastern Operator
item.description: EnerMech has been awarded a two-year contract extension to continue delivering offshore rig crane inspection to a Middle Eastern operator. This builds on the strong performance delivered by EnerMech’s lifting experts during the initial contract term.

item.title: UTIC Marks Milestone Year Advancing Undersea Tech Innovation
item.description: The Undersea Technology Innovation Consortium (UTIC) had a significant year of growth in 2025, expanding its membership and accelerating innovation in undersea and maritime technologies.
